label: The relation-of-reason account: cost, real decrees under N, and a joint model
paraphrase: Analyst certificate, attribution deferred. (1) On the relation-of-reason account (an invariant intrinsic profile, a real determination carrying the act, the act's actual terminus the effect, every terminus existing, the effect CONTINGENT_1), the act is performed at every accessible world and does not strictly suffice for the effect; no fact intrinsic to the source discriminates the effect's presence from its absence; the act's terminus discriminates it and is not intrinsic to the source. (2) For a real, exclusive decree family under N at one bearer (no accessible world gives it a determination it lacks), every decree it has at an accessible world is its actual decree; if that decree suffices for a contingent effect, some accessible world lacks the effect and has no decree at all. (3) On one finite carrier the account holds together with RootPurity, a30c5963, N at the root, 0c8631bd, both directions of member grounding, the existential PSR for contingents, some actual contingent concrete being, the failure of actual collapse and #555's IX.6/IsImmutable/ModalCapacity readings at the actual world. A structural surrogate only; nothing in the account mentions intellect.
